R118.summary: Written 15 October: the nuncio has communicated to Secretary Pérez everything Your Lordship (V.S. Ill.ma) wrote in the cipher of 19 September; Pérez has promised to report it to the King and obtain an answer, which will be sent at once. The clear Italian note on the leaf is the contemporary decipherment, minus the dateline; the year is open (Ormanetto in 1576 or Sega in 1577).
R118.en:
Written on the 15th of October. The Nuncio has communicated to Secretary Pérez everything that Your Most Illustrious
Lordship writes in the cipher of the 19th of September; the said Secretary has promised to give an account of it to the
King and to procure an answer, of which Your Most Illustrious Lordship will then be advised at once.

snip.cap: R118, f. 365: six lines of figures and, beneath, the nuncio’s clear note Il Nuntio ha trattato col Sig.r Perez

system: Homophonic substitution on digit signs (two per letter, dotted and undotted, zero rule), a stroke on 2/4/5 as word end, a small nomenclator, no doubled letters, final nulls: the Spain nunciature's 'cifra ordinaria'.
